extra_vocab.zh: 被捲入、深陷其中（get caught up in）
extra_vocab.en: to become so involved in something that it is hard to stop or think about other things
extra_vocab.note: 文章用 get caught up in an endless cycle of responsibilities，指被工作與期待一直推著走、身不由己地深陷其中，帶有「不知不覺被捲進去」的語感。單獨說 I'm all caught up 則是另一個意思：進度已經跟上了。
extra_vocab.pattern: get / be caught up in + N（或 V-ing）
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 固定搭配是 caught up in，介系詞用 in，不用 with 或 on；get 強調「變成被捲入」的過程，be 強調目前的狀態。

examples.en: I was caught up in a long meeting and missed your call.
examples.zh: 我被一場很長的會議絆住，沒接到你的電話。

examples.en: Many small firms got caught up in the price war.
examples.zh: 許多小公司被捲入了價格戰。

examples.en: Try not to get caught up in small details during planning.
examples.zh: 規劃階段請盡量不要陷在小細節裡。

examples.en: Give me an hour, and I will be all caught up.
examples.zh: 給我一個小時，我的進度就會全部跟上。

similar.diff: tied up 是忙得抽不開身，多指時間被占住；caught up in 強調被捲入、深陷其中。

example.en: Mr. Park is tied up in a client meeting until noon.
example.zh: 朴先生在客戶會議中忙到中午才有空。

similar.diff: absorbed in 是專注投入、多為正面；caught up in 帶有身不由己的被捲入感。

example.en: She was so absorbed in the data that she forgot lunch.
example.zh: 她太專注在數據上，連午餐都忘了。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，catch up on 是主動「補上落後的進度」；caught up in 是被動「被捲進去」。
confusable.usage: catch up on + 事情（補上進度）是主動動作；get caught up in 是被動，表示被捲入。

example.en: I need to catch up on my emails after the business trip.
example.zh: 出差回來後，我需要補看積壓的電子郵件。

extra_vocab.en: feeling thankful for something that someone did or gave
extra_vocab.note: 文章用 Let's be more grateful 呼籲大家對身邊的人事物心存感恩。商務上最常見於感謝信與請託信，如 I would be grateful if you could...，語氣正式又有禮貌。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 對象是人用 to、對象是事用 for：be grateful to + 人 for + 事（I'm grateful to you for your help）；也可接 that 子句。

example.en: We are grateful to our clients for their patience.
She was grateful for the extra time to finish the report.
example.zh: 她很感激有額外的時間完成報告。

example.en: I would be grateful if you could reply by Friday.
example.zh: 若您能在週五前回覆，我會非常感激。

example.en: The team is deeply grateful for your support this year.
example.zh: 團隊由衷感謝您今年的支持。

examples.en: I am grateful that you could join us on short notice.
examples.zh: 感謝您在臨時通知下仍能加入我們。

examples.en: The CEO said she was grateful to every employee.
examples.zh: 執行長說她感謝每一位員工。

examples.en: I'm grateful for the chance to work on this project.
examples.zh: 我很感激有機會參與這個專案。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音都很接近，但 graceful 是「優雅的」，和感謝無關。

example.en: The host gave a graceful speech at the opening dinner.
example.zh: 主持人在開幕晚宴上發表了優雅的演說。

similar.diff: thankful 偏重心裡慶幸、感恩的感受；grateful 更常用在對特定的人表示謝意，也較正式。

example.en: We are thankful that nobody was hurt in the accident.
example.zh: 我們很慶幸這次意外沒有人受傷。

similar.diff: appreciative 強調懂得欣賞、肯定對方的付出，語氣正式。

example.en: The manager was appreciative of the team's hard work.
example.zh: 經理很肯定團隊的辛勞。

example.en: We appreciate your quick response to our request.
example.zh: 我們感謝您迅速回覆我們的請求。

derived.link: 詞幹 grat- 表示「感謝」，加 -itude 變名詞，像 attitude。
